name: GLM-5.3 Flash

performance.note: The corrected complete-checkpoint probe reached the reference answer, but it missed Frontier performance thresholds and the broader certification gates remain outstanding.

description: Text-only GLM-5.3-Flash Frontier candidate using Red Hat AI's compressed-tensors NVFP4 checkpoint with native KDA, NoPE MLA/KPool, mHC, and NVMe-MoE serving.
limitations: The complete pinned checkpoint passed a precision-preserving FTW conversion and end-to-end API serving probe; the prepared artifact contains 1,498 entries across 24 shards.
This is a quantized derivative of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash; routed experts use NVFP4 while dense/KDA weights, the vision tower, embeddings, and output head retain their source precision.
The corrected probe reached the reference answer, but the measured 3.273 tok/s and 7.121 s warm TTFT miss Frontier performance thresholds and broader output parity remains outstanding.
FlashInfer 0.6.15's SM12x route packer exceeds Triton's tensor-size limit at 288 experts, so this recipe uses FreeToken's native Triton NVFP4 backend.
KPool sparse selection is currently eager and CUDA graph capture is disabled.
Multimodal certification is a separate later gate.
